description:
ARC BRIEF — Extend the author-field gate: CI Action + Sonnet-5 adjudication

FROM: Polybius the Hooker (user-tier fork overseeing u--xdo). TO: Polybius the Stoa + the-stoa gauntlet.
USER-TIER TRACKER: u--xdo (user-beadwork). FULL SPEC (context): C:\Users\denso\claude_projects\user-beadwork\plans\authorship-gate-build-spec.md — READ for background, but its greenfield framing is SUPERSEDED by the reconciliation in this brief (the substrate already has the gate; this is an EXTENSION).

WHAT THIS IS
Extend the EXISTING deterministic author-field gate — C:\Users\denso\claude_projects\the-stoa\substrate\hooks\pretooluse-author-field-audit.sh (Arc 46/65/69; stoa--xyb.5 / z2b / ez9). Do NOT rebuild it. Two additive deltas + a recall widen. Slot into the enforcement-hooks epic wherever Polybius the Stoa sees fit.

REUSE — do not fork:
- The allowlist: .claude/hooks/principal-identity + the per-file source-citation carve-out (parse_allow_pairs, exact-pair match).
- _hooklib.sh extract/classify machinery (classify_author_file, extract_author_fields).
- The regression corpus at substrate/hooks/tests/. EXTEND it; never replace it.

DELTA 1 — CI GitHub Action (the PRIMARY new coverage)
A server-side Action on pull_request + push that runs the author-field check over the PR diff / pushed tree and FAILS the required check on a violation -> blocks the merge. This is the unbypassable backstop that catches commits made OUTSIDE any Claude session (the existing PreToolUse gate only fires in-session; GitHub is the most common publish path). Ship a copy-deployable .github/workflows/authorship-gate.yml. The CI ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (for delta 2) = GitHub Actions ENCRYPTED SECRET, decrypted at runtime only, never on disk, no agent ever holds it (credential-discipline skill).

DELTA 2 — Sonnet-5 adjudication layer (model = claude-sonnet-5)
Purpose: close the §7 residual the existing gate DELIBERATELY punts — body-prose author claims that no mechanical predicate can separate from authorship-DISCUSSION prose. The adjudicator takes each greedy-grep hit surviving the deterministic allowlist and returns a STRUCTURED JSON verdict {is_authorship_claim, built_vs_referenced, names_non_denson, verdict, reason}. block iff authorship-claim on a BUILT artifact naming non-Denson; referenced/citation -> pass; ambiguous -> flag (surface, do not hard-block). Structured verdict only — never parse prose. This is what lets the term list widen (delta 3) without false-positive drowning.

DELTA 3 — widen the greedy term list (recall)
Widen the extractor from the current ~12 field words to the full spec §6 list: structured keys (author/authors/owner/creator/created_by/maintainer/contributor/developer/designer/writer/editor/publisher/vendor/holder/copyright/attribution/credit/by/byline/organization/brand/artist/composer/illustrator/skill-author/metadata.*), HTML meta + byline prose (<meta author/copyright/dc.creator>, og:author, JSON-LD author/creator/publisher, RSS/Atom author, "Built by / Made by / Created by / Presented by / © / All rights reserved"), and the file-type homes. Recall in the grep; precision in Sonnet-5. PRINCIPAL's rule: many false positives > ONE false negative.

PRESERVE (non-negotiable existing properties)
- FAIL-OPEN on hook script error (a buggy gate degrades to no-enforcement, never bricks the running team). NOTE the design tension for CI: a real violation FAILS the check (blocks merge), but a Sonnet/API ERROR in CI needs an explicit posture — recommend fail-the-check-with-"adjudicator-unavailable, human review" annotation (NOT silent pass); DAEDALUS/ARGUS to settle fail-open-vs-closed for the CI-API-error case in design.
- The self-contained deny-message authoring rule (hooks/README.md §2): every trigger payload states WHY it fired + WHAT to do, inline.
- The HARD SAFETY CONSTRAINT: install.sh deploys scripts INERT; arming is --enable-hooks (default-OFF); never auto-write a live settings.json.

ACCEPTANCE (hard bar) — ZERO FALSE NEGATIVES across the EXTENDED corpus
Existing tp/ + fp/ + control/ MUST still pass, PLUS new fixtures for: HTML <meta name="author"> naming non-Denson -> BLOCK; footer "Built by <other person>" -> BLOCK; a body-prose REAL "Author: <person>" claim -> BLOCK (via Sonnet-5); body-prose authorship-DISCUSSION -> pass; a wider-term hit that is a source citation -> pass. The four known-good patterns MUST clear cleanly: Denson-Smith field, CAPTAIN Co-Authored-By trailer, source-citation body, Denson git identity. Prove in ISOLATION (run-author-gate-tests.sh + a CI dry-run) before anything is armed.

OUT OF SCOPE — do NOT build: the Write/Edit creation gate; Artifact/Drive-MCP hooks. (Existing commit gate + CI covers the git path.)

DO NOT TOUCH: CLAUDE.md §4 — stays as full inline audit until this is built and green (spec §9). Paring §4 is a separate downstream step, not this arc.

CHAIN: escalations + the final merge/acceptance gate go UP to Polybius the Hooker (user-tier), NOT to PRINCIPAL. Run the-stoa's normal gauntlet; the Hooker gates the result against the acceptance bar above.

AUTHORSHIP: every artifact this arc produces (the .yml, the Sonnet client, fixtures, docs) is authored Denson Smith — the gate must pass its own dogfood.
title: Extend author-field gate: CI Action + Sonnet-5 adjudication (u--xdo / Polybius the Hooker)
